subject: BrightHealth renewal: forecast scrub & extension request
messages:
From: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@brighthealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: BrightHealth renewal (Q2) — data request & timeline

Marissa / Vivek,

We’re starting internal planning for our Q2 renewals and want to align on the BrightHealth contract coming up May 15. Can you confirm the following by EOD Thursday?

- Current committed spend + avg monthly usage for last 3 months (CSV preferred)
- Any outstanding quality or latency incidents in the past 90 days
- Your recommended retention levers (pilot extension / credits / feature bundling)

Attaching our usage export for your reference (BrightHealth_Q4_usage_report.csv). Procurement will need a mutual action plan so we can sign quickly if terms look right.

Thanks,
Dana Lopez
Sr. Manager, Platform Integrations
BrightHealth

[attachment: BrightHealth_Q4_usage_report.csv (csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@brighthealth.ai>, procurement@brighthealth.ai
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BrightHealth renewal (Q2) — data request & timeline

Hi Dana — thanks for the export. We’ll put together the numbers and a short MAP. Initial plan below — please confirm deadlines:

Mutual action plan (proposed)
- By Tue 2/24: Redwood provides consolidated usage + week-by-week delta and churn-risk summary (deliverable: MAP_BrightHealth_v1.docx)
- By Thu 2/26: Commercial team to propose extension/credit terms and updated SOW
- By Fri 3/05: Procurement & legal to confirm redlines / DocuSign ready

Immediate asks for you:
- Confirm whether procurement will accept a 6-week pilot extension in lieu of a financial credit (this helps us avoid a major price escalation now)
- Any timing constraints from your finance team for PO cut-off

I’m attaching the MAP we’ll iterate on. Vivek will own the risk score and Ben will own pricing. Laura — can you slot this into your commercial queue for 2/26?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

[attachment: MAP_BrightHealth_v1.docx (docx)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T08:46:00-08:00
Subject: RE: BrightHealth renewal (Q2) — data request & timeline

Marissa / team,

Quick risk note after a first-pass on the export:
- 30% of ARR concentrated in three high-variance clusters (week-on-week spikes tied to a single pilot).
- Churn signal: two support incidents in Jan with SLA misses; flagged as medium impact.
- Suggested action: offer a six-week technical extension + 25% discount on overage for the pilot window rather than a broad credit. That reduces immediate cash exposure while addressing product concerns.

I’ve attached a one-page risk matrix (churn_risk_matrix.xlsx) with recommended outreach cadence (day 0, day 7, day 21, exec check-in at day 30). Ben — please align pricing to the suggested offset so the CFO sees net-neutral exposure.

Vivek
Senior Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

[attachment: churn_risk_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@brighthealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-22T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BrightHealth renewal (Q2) — data request & timeline

Dana — following up with commercial terms we can move quickly on. Per internal risk guidance, proposal below: 

- 6-week technical extension (no interruption to inference pipelines)
- 25% concession on overage charges during the extension period
- No change to baseline committed rate; SOW updated to include extension window and success criteria

If that sounds acceptable, we’ll prepare a short SOW amendment and send for signature. I’ve attached the draft SOW (SOW_extension_v3.pdf) — comments welcome.

Ben / Marissa — thank you. Procurement is willing to accept a 6-week extension with the overage concession; legal wants a short SOW amendment and an explicit success criterion for the pilot (stability + latency targets). If you can return the final SOW by EOD Monday 2/29, we’ll queue it for the 3/05 PO run.

One more ask: can you include the consolidated forecast showing expected ARR if the customer reduces consumption by 20% vs. baseline? We need that in the PO packet.

Dana Lopez
Sr. Manager, Platform Integrations
BrightHealth
